pages.title: Redirection Game
pages.text: Rotate the tiles to make them all match on the Red Arrow. Right-Clicking an arrow causes it and it's adjacent blocks to swap states to the next clockwise arrow.

pages.title: Geo-Coordinated Orb
pages.text: The Geo-Coordinated Orb starts the game when used on the Redirection Chamber.

pages.title: Geo-redirection Orb
pages.text: A Geo-redirection Orb is given for succesfully completing the game.
